loose-limit.label: Loose limit
loose-limit.desc: M5 break may come after MX is re-tested (MX re-anchors), no speed / overlap / flip filters, R:R over 1.5, no stop cap, limit at the order block open, fills on a touch, lives 48 M5 bars.

market-break.label: Market on the break
market-break.desc: Same manipulation; entry at market on the close of the bar after the M5 break, stop beyond MX, target the accumulation extreme, R:R over 1.5, no stop cap, no quality filters: every setup with a break becomes a trade.

note: What the pre-registered LIT rule would have done on OANDA 5m gold over this window, simulated as the study did (costs $0.30 spread + $0.15 slippage on market exits in Rnet; Rnet2 doubles them). Paper research, not the live shadow stream's records. The study's verdict (inconclusive, 2008-2026) stands.
